data.name: Intro.Text
data.value: Choose which toolbar each role gets in the rich text editor, how large a file each role may upload, and where files dropped or pasted into the editor are saved. Folder permissions still decide where each user can browse and upload.

data.name: AllSitesHelp.Text
data.value: These settings apply to every site that does not set its own value.

data.name: SiteHelp.Text
data.value: Values left empty here use the settings for all sites. A site that sets any toolbar or upload limit for a role replaces the whole role list for all sites.

data.name: RolesHelp.Text
data.value: A user in several roles gets the largest toolbar and the largest upload limit of those roles. Users in none of them get the defaults above. If no role has a toolbar, administrators get the full toolbar. Upload folder paths are relative to the site's root folder, for example Images/.

data.name: Saved.Text
data.value: The editor settings have been saved.

data.name: InvalidLimit.Text
data.value: Upload limits must be whole numbers of KB greater than zero, or empty.

data.name: FolderNotFound.Text
data.value: The upload folder does not exist in this site.

data.name: AccessDenied.Text
data.value: Only superusers can change the editor settings.
